# Sweep report, seeds 0-9 (auto-generated by experiments/analyze.py; the headline claim lives in CLAIM.md)

At 90% weight sparsity (achieved 0.9000) on sklearn digits with a 64-128-64-10 MLP, Fisher/OBD self-pruning reaches **96.60%** mean test accuracy (99.5% of dense 97.05%) versus **96.69%** for magnitude pruning (99.6% of dense), averaged over 10 seeds with identical schedule, budget, init and batch order (paired).

Paired difference: -0.08 pp, 95% bootstrap CI [-0.50, +0.39] pp, wins/ties/losses 3/2/5, exact sign-flip p = 0.8203.

How to falsify: rerun `python experiments/run_sweep.py && python experiments/analyze.py` with different seeds (N_SEEDS, or shift SEEDS); the claim fails if the 95% CI of the paired difference includes 0 or flips sign.

Test-set note: 359 test images, so one image = 0.28 pp. Accuracy is measured once at the end of training; nothing (no early stopping, no hyper-parameter choice) was selected on the test set during the sweep.
